Done — `answer.json` is written to the workspace with all three questions answered and validated for format.

**How each answer was derived:**

**Q1 (CoachForce Market Research Report authors + key reviewers):** The report (`cofoaix_market_research_report`) was authored by Julia Smith (`eid_890654c4`). The dedicated review meeting `CoFoAIX_planning_1` — whose `document_type` field explicitly links it to the Market Research Report — has 7 participants whose names exactly match the 7 attendees who gave section-by-section feedback in the transcript (Ian Jones, Hannah Miller, George Miller, Julia Garcia, Julia Davis, George Jones, Charlie Smith). Note the dataset has many employees sharing names, so I used the eid-explicit fields rather than name matching. Answer: those 8 employee IDs.

**Q2 (insights on PersonalizeForce competitor strengths/weaknesses):** Team members led discussions on three competitor products — PersonaAI, SmartSuggest, and TailorAI — across the `planning-PersonalizeForce`, `planning-PersonalizeForce-PM`, and `develop-juliamartinez-PersonalizeForce` channels. The insight providers (each explicitly acknowledged with "thanks for the insights" and the substantive analysis authors) are: `eid_5318af37` (TailorAI + SmartSuggest weaknesses), `eid_a253c65a` (TailorAI strengths/weaknesses), `eid_c9c3d8d5` (SmartSuggest), `eid_d2f0f99a` (PersonaAI, aka David Davis), and `eid_fce6544f` (PersonaAI weaknesses, aka Charlie Brown).

**Q3 (competitor demo URLs):** Slack messages shared exactly three competitor product demos — `https://personaai.com/demo`, `https://smartsuggest.com/demo`, `https://tailorai.com/demo` (confirmed also in the `urls` collection). The other demo URLs in the data (`.../PersonalizeForce/demo_1`–`demo_6`) are PersonalizeForce's own product demos, so they were excluded.

One judgment call worth flagging: for Q1, three people (Ian Garcia, Fiona Martinez, Ian Brown) also gave Slack feedback on the report draft and were thanked by the author. I counted the "key reviewers" as the 7 participants of the dedicated review meeting, since the meeting's `document_type` field is the corpus's designed link between reviewers and the document, and the transcript shows that meeting performing the actual document review.
